purpose: Open the native-latent-mathematics program; prior program archived under legacy/
Smoke-test the substitution-probe harness (CPU fp32) and measure the CPU numerical null before the first preregistered measurement
notes: 12 toy words x 4 probes. Directed asymmetry is 4 orders of magnitude above the numerical null on this toy set; not a result, a calibration for the preregistration. Null must be stated as batched-vs-single, not repeat.

purpose: End-to-end pipeline validation and instrument calibration on 8 items (2 per class, overlapping the frozen 80) BEFORE the confirmatory run; not a result
command: python experiments/run_lexical_closeness.py --config smoke8.json --systems Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --out pipeline_smoke_8; python experiments/analyze_lexical_closeness.py --run pipeline_smoke_8
notes: Preregistered robustness rule (|median|>3*MAD over 4 paraphrases) is unreachable: paraphrases within a block differ in KL scale by up to 16x, so paraphrase MAD measures carrier scale heterogeneity, not noise. Closeness orderings reproduce across paraphrases far above chance; directed asymmetry signs do not (approx chance). Design must be amended before the 80-item run: per-paraphrase scale normalization, sign rule with a proper chance null, and a stronger asymmetry measurement. Disclosed in the preregistration amendment.
Highest-leverage item is the instrument's robustness rule and the asymmetry measurement, being settled with Codex before the confirmatory run. No plumbing drift.

purpose: NLM-001 confirmatory analysis (analysis-preregistered over sequestered data; fea3a8f lock)
command: python experiments/analyze_lexical_closeness.py --run nlm001_v1 --config experiments/config/lexical_probe_v1.json --scale-normalize --rule pooled --exclude dog cat run walk red blue the of --tag analysis_primary_72
notes: Kill conditions 3 (predictive novelty), 6 (coordinate confound), 8 (instrument metadata recorded post hoc) apply. Q>1 supported in Qwen and SmolLM (SmolLM W~0). Directedness absent. Bounded negative falsifier; not a confirmatory result either way. Tier-3 fresh audit (.codex_audit_t3_001.md) findings adopted.

purpose: Post-verdict reading of the full predictor table (no new analysis)
notes: Unlearned centered contextual cosine at layer 14 beats native calibration-KL on held-out orderings (1.000 vs 0.954) on reversal-active anchors; the preregistered selection rule (calibration accuracy) chose an overfit diagonal Mahalanobis (calib 1.000, held-out 0.947), so the reported delta understates the native loss. Near-ceiling accuracies for every predictor indicate the robust held-out labels are large-gap, easy pairs — an instrument limitation for NLM-002 design.
